requirement: Risk analysis and information system security policies
what_done_looks_like: Approved policy and a living risk register with owners and treatment dates
evidence_to_request: Risk register, policy approval minute, review date
sample_test: Pick three risks and check that treatment, owner and residual risk are recorded

what_done_looks_like: A process that detects, triages, escalates and reports; tested at least once
evidence_to_request: Runbook, on-call rota, one exercise or post-incident report
sample_test: Check that the runbook carries the 24-hour early warning, the 72-hour incident notification and the one-month final report, then read the last notification log

requirement: Business continuity, backup management and crisis management
what_done_looks_like: Backups restore successfully; RTO and RPO are stated and met
evidence_to_request: Restore test log with date, RTO/RPO document, crisis contact list
sample_test: Read the latest restore test and compare it with the stated RTO and RPO

what_done_looks_like: Critical suppliers are inventoried, assessed and covered by security clauses
evidence_to_request: Supplier register, due-diligence notes, contract clauses
sample_test: Pick three suppliers and check the register entry, the assessment notes and the contract clause

requirement: Security in acquisition, development and maintenance
what_done_looks_like: Secure build and change process, vulnerability handling with a patch window
evidence_to_request: Change records, code review or SBOM, patch SLA report
sample_test: Check the last five vulnerability fixes and the window they were closed in

requirement: Assessing the effectiveness of the measures
what_done_looks_like: At least one independent check per cycle: audit, test or scan with fixes tracked
evidence_to_request: Audit or test report, remediation tracker with closures
sample_test: Check that the test covered the critical systems and that the findings were closed

what_done_looks_like: Role-based training with records, plus phishing or tabletop practice
sample_test: Check coverage and freshness of the training, not the attendance count

what_done_looks_like: Encryption at rest and in transit with managed keys and an inventory
evidence_to_request: Key inventory, configuration baseline, exception list
sample_test: Trace where data moves, then check encryption in place and the certificate expiry list

requirement: HR security, access control and asset management
what_done_looks_like: Joiner-mover-leaver process, least privilege, reviewed privileged access
evidence_to_request: Access review minutes, asset inventory, offboarding records
sample_test: Pick five accounts, including one leaver, and check rights and the asset record

what_done_looks_like: MFA enforced on remote and privileged access; emergency comms agreed
evidence_to_request: MFA coverage report, policy, out-of-band contact list
sample_test: Check MFA on the critical accounts and that the out-of-band emergency channel works

requirement: Management body duties: approve, oversee, be accountable, follow training
what_done_looks_like: Board minute approving the risk management measures, plus training evidence
evidence_to_request: Board minute, training record, named member with contact details for the authority
sample_test: Read the latest board minute and the training record; confirm who the designated member is
